d.ko: An accidental fire at a funeral forces the police to re-investigate a closed case of massacre. Lin Lixun participates the re-investigation by chances. As the investigation goes deeper, the past of the victims gradually emerges. However, the case becomes more bewildering.
d.en: An accidental fire at a funeral forces the police to re-investigate a closed case of massacre. Lin Lixun participates the re-investigation by chances. As the investigation goes deeper, the past of the victims gradually emerges. However, the case becomes more bewildering.
d.zh: 《烟火》是一款中国本土题材的恐怖悬疑解谜游戏。故事发生在偏远的山中小镇，一场葬礼上的意外火灾牵扯出一宗已经结案的灭门惨案。新人警察林理洵在机缘巧合下重新调查灭门案，随着调查深入，受害者的过往慢慢浮出水面，案子真相却变得扑朔迷离……

rv.t: 평이 워낙 좋아서 한번 해봤습니다 공포스러운게 0은 아니지만 그냥 분위기가 스산하다 정도였어요 게임이 참 예쁘게 만들어졌다는 생각을 플레이하는 동안 해봤습니다 다만 그 예쁨이 곱게 염한 시신을 보는듯한 그런 아름다움입니다 시신이란건 기분나쁜거지만 그 각각 사연을 알게되면 애처롭잖아요 …
중간에 살짝 루즈하게 느껴졌지만 재밌음 별로 안무서워요
짧은 분량임에도 늘어지는 스토리텔링 탓에, 체감 플레이 타임은 오히려 길게 느껴졌습니다. 2021년작이라기엔 믿기 힘들 만큼 연출이 2010년대 초반 수준으로 투박하며, 인물들의 감정선 또한 전혀 와닿지 않아 도대체 왜 '압도적으로 긍정적' 평가를 받는지 의문만 남습니다.
The most frightening thing is not a ghost leaping out, but the long-running, human-made tragedy that clings to everything. The chill it leaves behind lasts far longer than any jump scare ever could.
The biggest gap between Chinese n Western horror is how Chinese horror nails that slow-burn creeping dread that sticks with u long after u wrap up a playthrough. …

the first 20 minutes are really intriguing, then my interest started waning rapidly because... idk, i believe this was marketed as survival horror, but the puzzles are too juvenile and too few and far in between. …
